title: The Shell That Bounced Back
set_language: ONE persistent Manchester 1909 dark scattering lab (gold foil, scintillation screen, microscope); then empty football stadium pea metaphor; then 1910s study desk for the charge-guess beat. Say 'same 1909 dark scattering set' / 'same empty stadium set' / 'same study desk'. Never 'same DNA'. Never name Rutherford/Geiger/Marsden/Thomson/van den Broek in Flow prompts.
continuity_lock: Picture change every 4–6 s. Explorer once only on stadium pea. Readable finished faces when people appear — describe, do not name. Real element symbols only if any (prefer blank boards).
explorer_lock: Exactly ONE Explorer plate: 16_explorer_stadium_pea. Film-wide Explorer budget: 1 used (Part 02); this plate = 2 of 3. On model — round gold glasses, teal coat, finished hair. Attach Explorer reference.
forbidden: HARD REJECT: Orbit; photoreal; Ken Burns; gore; lava drip; DNA helix; naming Rutherford/Geiger/Marsden/Thomson/van den Broek in the prompt; garbled dials; SEE labels; Explorer except plate 16; war gore.
motion_lock: Real Veo motion every plate. No freeze-pad.
quality_note: Veo 3.1 Quality for green scintillation / alpha glow / nucleus glow / charge-link glow. Fast otherwise.
credit_fallback: If Flow credits would drop below ~150 buffer, mint remaining plates with the SAME Veo 3.1 model via Gemini API (Quality→veo-3.1-generate-preview, Fast→veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview). Log path+spend per plate. Never mix other models.
board_split_2026_09_27: Split prior 10-plate board into 22 plates ≤~6 s for picture-change rule.

plates.vo_land: Manchester, nineteen-oh-nine. Ernest Rutherford has a new kind of bullet.
plates.prompt: Animistry premium 3D cartoon. Manchester 1909 dark scattering lab. Bearded physicist with a big moustache stands at a gold-foil apparatus on a wooden bench — readable finished face. Continuous soft approach. Silent. No Explorer. No Orbit. No readable fake text.
plates.prompt_try2: Same 1909 lab. Wider: apparatus fills frame, physicist soft in background. Continuous soft push. Silent. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Alpha particles, tiny and fast, thrown out by radioactive rocks.
plates.prompt: Animistry premium 3D cartoon. Same 1909 dark scattering lab. Rough radioactive rock samples on the bench emit tiny glowing alpha particles that stream toward the foil apparatus — ONE clear action. Continuous particle stream. Quality clean glow, no lava drip. Silent. No Explorer. No Orbit. No room-wide tube flare.
plates.prompt_try2: Same 1909 lab. ECU: rough rock samples; tiny glowing particles leave the rock surface one after another. Continuous leave. Quality. Silent. No Explorer. No multi-lamp flare.
plates.still_prompt: Finished 3D cartoon still. 1909 lab bench: rough radioactive rocks emit a thin stream of tiny glowing particles toward a gold-foil frame. One action. No Explorer. No text.
